title: Handwritten digit recognition
subtitle: Recognize digits 0-9 from 8x8 pixel images
about: 1,797 8x8 grayscale images of handwritten digits; `pixel_r_c` columns hold intensities 0-16. `digit` is the label.
source: UCI Machine Learning Repository: Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits, E. Alpaydin and C. Kaynak (1998). Distributed with scikit-learn.
